title: Onboard seraph-13b v1.0: performance profiles and changelog automation
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Add Seraph-13B v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata, curated performance profiles, and automated changelog/release-note generation.

This PR does three things in a single atomic change so downstream infra and changelog automation remain consistent:
- Add canonical metadata and model manifest for seraph-13b v1.0 under models/seraph-13b/v1.0/
- Add performance profiles (latency/throughput/memory/quantization recommendations) used by the serving runtime and the perf dashboard
- Wire up changelog automation so new model metadata changes automatically contribute to release notes (GitHub Actions + changelog template)

Checklist:
- [x] Basic metadata (model name, architecture, tokenizer, repo link)
- [x] Performance profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes
- [x] Quick sanity perf validation run in perf-lab (summary in commits)
- [x] Changelog automation workflow and template
- [x] Documentation updates (registry README + model page)

Notes and links:
- Model artifact reference: https://internal-artifacts.redwood.ai/seraph/13b/v1.0
- Perf lab run: perf-canary job seraph-13b-v1.0-20260222 (see CI checks)
- Linear tickets: ENG-2891 (onboard model), PM-107 (product signoff)

Implementation details:
- metadata.json contains model fields used by the console and ingestion tooling. Important keys: "model_id", "architecture", "supported_seq_lens", "tokenizer", "artifact_uri", "license", "hashes".
- perf_profile.yaml includes entries per sequence length: target_latency_ms, throughput_rps, recommended_quantization (int8/llm-int8/float16), gpu_memory_bytes_estimate, notes. These profiles are used by the runtime to select kernel/quantization recommendations and by Redwood Optimize.
- changelog automation: adds .github/workflows/model-changelog.yml plus scripts/changelog/generate_release_notes.py which parse model metadata diffs and append structured changelog entries. The workflow triggers on push to main with changes in models/**.

Migration/compatibility:
- No breaking changes to existing registry schema; optional fields added with defaults. The new automation is opt-in for now and guarded by a registry config flag.

Follow-ups (separate PRs):
- Extend perf validation matrix to AWD/half-precision TPU targets (ENG-2905)
- Add short-lived canary endpoint in Dedicated for live perf verification (PM-120)
